_comment: Copy to summary_variants.json (git-ignored) and write your OWN summaries. Only facts that are true and already on your master resume. Keys: software, data_ml, devops_cloud, analyst, support, default. Any key you omit falls back to 'default', then to the summary in master_resume.txt. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

en.software: Software engineering graduate who builds and tests Python/web applications ... (use only facts from your master resume)
en.data_ml: Software engineering graduate with hands-on machine-learning project experience ... (use only facts from your master resume)
en.analyst: Software engineering graduate with IT support and requirements-gathering experience ... (use only facts from your master resume)
en.support: IT support analyst with ... (use only facts from your master resume)
